hooks.command:
last_ts=$(git log -1 --format='%ct' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); now=$(date +%s); msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); age=$((now - last_ts)); [ "$age" -lt 15 ] && echo "$msg" | grep -qE '^(feat|refactor):' && printf '
DOC-CHECK: feat/refactor commit detected.
Does this change product vocabulary, user-facing behaviour, or architecture?
If so, update the relevant doc before the session ends:
  docs/PRODUCT.md          -- rating model, crew model, positioning, launch checklist
  CLAUDE.md                -- Current State snapshot, stack, architecture rules
  docs/RATING_MATRIX.md    -- scoring formula, CompatibilityScore type
  docs/CREW_VIEW_DESIGN.md -- crew UI design decisions
  docs/ITINERARY_DESIGN.md -- itinerary layer model
' || true
